name: latex-bilingual-review
title_zh: LaTeX 论文中英对照审阅稿
tagline_zh: 把 .tex 历史版本差异渲染成可点选批注的 HTML，中英逐段对照。批注存在浏览器里，导出 JSON 随时接着评。
tagline_en: Turn .tex history into a paragraph-by-paragraph CN-EN review HTML. Click to comment, comments persist in-browser.
desc_en: Generates a bilingual Chinese-English HTML review of a LaTeX paper, with Word-style track-changes diffs against a git or file history, plus selectable comments that persist via localStorage and JSON export. Use when the user asks for 中英对照, 全文对照, 历史版本对比, Word 审阅, track changes, bilingual review, paragraph-by-paragraph translation of a .tex paper, or commentable review HTML.
why_zh: 不是翻译，是审阅。git diff 进、双语对照出，批注像 Word 修订一样挂在句子上。
why_en: Not a translator—a reviewer. Git diff in, bilingual diff out. Comments anchor to sentences like Word track changes, surviving.
limit_zh: 只认 .tex 源文件，需有 git 历史或文件备份做差异源；输出是 HTML 不是 .docx。
limit_en: Requires .tex source with git/file history for diffing. Outputs HTML only (not .docx). Comments live in one browser's localStorage; export JSON to.
title_en: Bilingual HTML review of LaTeX papers with track-changes.
